title: 没工作没多少钱：他搬去意大利，后来进了纽约时报？
speaker: Jason Horowitz

segments.en: All right, and so I took it. I had, you know, I moved to Italy, I had no job, I had nothing. I had, you know, I didn't have a ton of money, but I went.
segments.zh: 我抓住了机会。我搬到意大利，没工作，什么都没有。钱也不多，但我去了。

segments.en: And you know, I got lucky, things broke my way. But things would not have broken my way if I didn't go.
segments.zh: 我运气好，事情顺利。但如果我没去，就不会顺利。

segments.en: Based on Horowitz moving on to a new hardship post, he's in Madrid now for the New York Times.
segments.zh: 霍洛维茨接着去了新的艰苦岗位，他现在在马德里为纽约时报工作。

segments.en: Great to speak with him, and it's a wonderful book. It's really great. It's a great title, full of fun anecdotes that we really enjoyed our time.
segments.zh: 很高兴与他交谈，这本书很棒。标题很好，充满趣闻，我们很享受。
